$comment: English interface strings of Nirvan Sutra, transcreated from locales/hi/ui.json.

strings.languageChanged: Language changed. Your progress is just as it was.
strings.lockedHint: This opens when the previous stage is complete.
strings.notInYourLanguage: This part is not in your language yet; until then it is shown in {lang}.
strings.draftNote: This written part is a draft for review; the teaching film is the final source.
strings.chooseLanguageTitle: In which language would you like to make this journey?
strings.chooseLanguageNote: The whole course — lessons, questions and the voice of the films — will be in your language. You can change it later; no progress is lost.
strings.introTitle: A quiet journey from inquiry toward direct seeing
strings.introBody1: This is not an ordinary course. Over seventeen stages, the journey slowly examines what you have assumed about yourself — from ignorance to inquiry, from the witness to self-inquiry, and from silence to natural living.
strings.introBody2: Every stage has a main teaching film, a written essence, a small experiment, an understanding check and ten deep questions.
strings.introBody3: There is no competition here and no hurry. Take as much time as you need.
strings.introNamePrompt: What name may we call you? (optional)
strings.startTitle: The first stage is waiting for you
strings.suggestionWatch: Watch the main film of Stage {n}, then try the ‘See for yourself’ experiment.
strings.suggestionCheck: The film is watched. Now take the three questions of the understanding check.
strings.suggestionQuestions: Choose one of this stage's deep questions — the one most alive in you.
strings.suggestionFinal: All seventeen stages are complete. The overall understanding check is waiting for you.
strings.reflectionsEmpty: The reflection you write at the end of each stage will be kept here — for you alone.
strings.nidLockedNote: When the knowledge journey is complete, three months of guided nididhyāsana will open.
strings.deeperNote: These ten questions are optional — not needed for the next stage. Start with the one that is most alive in you.
strings.reflectionPlaceholder: What you saw, as you saw it — write honestly. This is for you alone.
strings.filmPlaceholderNote: This film is still being made. Until then, its full narration can be read below.
strings.markWatched: I have watched / read the main film
strings.transcriptHindiNote: The narration in your language arrives with the film; until then, the approved Hindi narration.
strings.reqCheck: Clarify all three questions of the understanding check
strings.stageCompleteNote: This completes one stage of the curriculum — not the attainment of any state.
strings.questionReflection: Test this question on your own experience today. Write what you saw.
strings.checkWrong: The difference between two things is not clear here yet.
strings.assessmentIntro: This check is not here to give you marks. It is here to see which distinctions would be useful to clarify again.
strings.assessmentLocked: This checkpoint opens when Stage {n} is complete.
strings.finalSub: A quiet review of what was understood across the seventeen stages
strings.finalLocked: This check opens when all seventeen stages are complete.
strings.finalBelow: It would be useful to clarify a few distinctions further.
strings.finalBelowNote: Look again at the stages where the distinctions stayed blurred, then come back. There is no limit.
strings.finalPassedNote: This means only that you have shown an understanding of the Nirvan Sutra curriculum, so you can go on into nididhyāsana. It is not proof of any spiritual attainment.
strings.phase1DoneTitle: The first cycle of understanding is complete.
strings.phase1DoneBody: Now what has been understood is to be seen again and again in life.
strings.nidTransitionTitle: Understanding will now be tested in life.
strings.nidTransitionBody: The next three months are not another information course. They are for direct observation, questions, clarification, repeated inquiry and integration into life — with guidance.
strings.nidSessionPending: The session link will appear here before the session.
strings.nidAttended: I took part in this week's session
strings.nidDoubtPlaceholder: Write the question or doubt that arose. It will be taken up in the next session.
strings.nidRecordingSoon: The recording will appear here after the session.
strings.finalReflectionIntro: These questions have no right or wrong. Write only what is truly seen today. Your answers stay private and will not be read as any achievement.
strings.finalReflectionLocked: The final reflection opens when the twelve weeks of nididhyāsana are complete.
strings.finalReflectionShort: Write at least a few lines for every question.
strings.journeyEndBody: it simply no longer needs a course.
strings.certificateText: has successfully completed the Nirvan Sutra Program, including the 17-stage Knowledge Journey and the three-month guided Nididhyāsana integration period.
strings.certificateDisclaimer: This certificate records completion of the program only. It is not proof of any spiritual state, self-knowledge or attainment.
strings.certificateNotYet: Still to complete for the certificate:
strings.settingsLanguageNote: Changing the language never loses any progress.
strings.glossaryNote: These Sanskrit terms are kept in their original form in every language, with their meaning.
strings.devPanelNote: Local development only. Hidden in production.
strings.graphicLabel: A teaching sketch — a metaphor, not a claim
strings.lPhase1Body: Seventeen stages of teaching films, written essence, experiments in seeing for yourself and checks of understanding — at your own pace, without hurry.
strings.lPhase2Body: Once the knowledge journey is complete, twelve weeks of guided Nididhyāsana: a pointer each week, private reflection and sessions with a guide.
strings.lFilmDesc: A main teaching film that opens the subject simply and directly.
strings.lEssenceDesc: The written essence of the film and its key distinctions, to read again and again.
strings.lObserveDesc: A short experiment in which the point is checked in your own experience.
strings.lCheckDesc: Three questions that show which distinction is clear and which is not yet.
strings.lDeeperDesc: Ten deep questions with short films that take the inquiry further inward.
strings.lMapSub: Four movements, seventeen stages. Each stage carries one central inquiry.
strings.lStep1: Create your Nirvan Dham account, or log in.
strings.lStep2: Tell us your name. Your language is already chosen.
strings.lStep3: Begin the journey with the teaching film of the first stage.
strings.lHonest: This course promises no attainment of any state. It is a quiet, disciplined opportunity to look carefully at yourself.
strings.lHaveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
strings.lOldCourse: On the earlier eight-chapter course? Continue there
strings.lFilmsSoon: The teaching films are being added stage by stage; until then the full narration of each stage can be read.
strings.nextDoFilm: Watch the main film or read its full narration, then press {button}.
strings.nextDoCheck: Now answer the three questions of the understanding check.
strings.nextDoComplete: Everything is ready. Complete the stage and the next one opens.
strings.nextDoNext: This stage is complete. On to the next stage.
strings.nextDoCheckpoint: This stage is complete. Now take the checkpoint of this movement.
